summary.text: Micheál O'Leary, an independent small business owner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 5th District to Charlie Hatcher.
Ballotpedia lists no campaign website or Candidate Connection survey response for him.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia profile, O'Leary studied agricultural sciences at University College Dublin. The profile lists his career experience as that of a small business owner.
He received 0.4% of the vote to Charlie Hatcher's 51.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
